translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Aaen John Baptist Fenai

Noan miniwe seig me nimowu raeg aan Soamwoonin Rome we Tiberius nemenem, nge Pontius Pilate minne governor reen Judea, nge Erotes minne soamwoonin Galilee, iwe nge Philip we pwiin minne soamwoonin faniuwaen Iturea me Trachonitis; iwe nge Lysanias minne soamwoonin Abilene,
iwe nge Annas me Caiaphas minikka Patere taegias — noan oatonaan nge Deus a fang to kkepas reen John iwe naiun Zechariah me noan desert we.
Iwe John a noa fenai fetaen noan faniuwaen rhan pwupwu na Jordan, “Toagun saengi monofitimi nge oawpwe paptismus, ina nge Deus epwe saeneti noa monofitimi.”
Miniwe effoat noan pwapwior we aaen profeta Isaiah pwe:

content.text: “Erhai aeremas e iyaekkepwas me noan desert we nge e iura pwe:
oawpwe awenecchera eew aan pwe epwe faaeraeg wooan!
Oanongaen mwoattotiw nepetaen rhug nge sipwe oawutaeni tae,
oanongaen taeiit me rhug nge epwe soan eew noa rhag.
Oanongaen aan pwoar nge epwe aewwen noa,
oanongaen aan toarumwrumw nge epwe arhannenoa.
Oanongeer aeremas nge repwe weri menaw na Deus epwene fangetiw!’ ”

content: Aeremas towunap ra maeg wow reen John pwe epwe noa paptismus aeginiir. Nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Aaemi sowufaeng! Iyo e aengaenigaemi pwe oawpwe mmwenen kkewaeg saengi aaen Deus aegaeregaer iga epwe aefengato?

Oaw ssiuweniy wegitaegimi pwe epwe pwaeri noa pwe oawwa toagun saengi monofitimi. Oawsoapw niunniuwaennei pwe oawwa taaw saengi aaen Deus aegaeregaer reen aaemi aepesa pwe Abraham minne rhaepetomi. Ngaang ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe Deus emmwenen feeori faai kaan pwe tettaenin Abraham!
Eew soapaen a oamoannatae pwe epwe gopiy tiw waniwan saengi waeran. Oanongaen waniwan kka ese gacch uwaan nge epwe gopogop tiw nge e aekkaerh nong noan aengaet.”
Aeremas ra aeiineow pwe, “Meeta minne aeipwe feeori?”
A paniuwaeniir pwe, “Iyo na riiuwapeo mengaagiun nge epwe fangenoa epeo pwe mengaagiun manna esooar mengaagiun, iwe nge iyo na eyor mwongo reen nge epwe fang ngaeniir aaemweoi.”
Aaemweoi rhooan iyoiyon tax re itto pwe repwe paptismus, iwe nge ra aeiineow pwe, “Sinsei, meeta aemaem aeipwe feeori?”
Nge iiy a aengaeniir pwe, “Oawsoapw iyoiy tax temoag saengi minna eno noan oasoapwosoapw.”

Aaemweoi sonotaw ra pwan aeiineow pwe, “Iwe nge aemaem? Meeta aemaem aeipwe feeori?” Nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Oawsoapw pweipwog senaapiy saengiir aeremas noan amamaaw ngaere oatupwutupw tae kkepas wooan erhai. Oawsoapw tipinap saengi minikkena paniuwaemi noan engaang.”
Aar aepiniugiuniug aeremas a tettemoag noa reen miniwe mwaenian, iwe nge a rhaepetae aar niunniuwaennei ngaere teorh maeni pwe John minne Kristus.

John a aengaeniir oanongeer noa pwe, “Ngaang iya paptismusaegaemi reen rhaan, iwe nge erhai ina epwe itto nge e taegias me mmwaei. Ngaang mwo nge ese fin ipwe pwaeisi geeogeeon nokkaan. Iiy epwe paptismusaegaemi ngaeni Espritu Santus me aengaet.

A kkemwarh aan sepwin pwe epwe aeyimweoiuw fesaenngiy faiun saengi peeon. Iwe, epwe ioni fengaenniy faiun nge a iseni nong noan aan imwaen iseis, nge peeon epwe oatoranong noan aengaet we ese mmwenen gunnoa.”
E towunap mesemesaen aaen John fenaiuw Kkepas Mwamwaai we ngaeniir aeremas nge e aemaemaewa ngaeniir pwe repwe ssiuweniy meneweer.
Iwe nge John a soong ngaeni Governor Erotes, pwe igiwe e rhooan ngaenne aeni Herodias, iwe rhooan ngaenneyaen mwaaen we pwiin, iwe me igiwe e towunap min aenneew kkewe efeeori.
Iwe egius mwo nge Erotes a faer gin feeori aenneewa noa pwe a iseni nong John noan kanepwus.
Aaen Jesus Paptismus
Mwirin aar oanongeer aeremas paptismus, Jesus a pwan paptismus. Nugunupaen aan maeipin nge a susu noa naaeng,
iwe nge Espritu Santus a ittiw wooan eweei rhag erhai dove. Iwe nge eew mangiungiu a ittiw me noan naaeng nge a aepesa pwe, “Een naeyi mwaaen aerhaengerhaeng. Iye efin tipaei reen.”
